# FluentAzure

> Guard rails for .NET 8/10 configuration on Azure: fail-fast startup validation, secret redaction, health checks and compile-time analyzers. They work on top of Microsoft's App Configuration and Key Vault providers (`services.AddFluentAzureGuard(...)`), or with FluentAzure's own fluent pipeline, which loads from environment variables, JSON, Key Vault and App Configuration, as a standalone `Result`-based builder or a Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration provider with IOptionsMonitor<T> reload, managed identity, OpenTelemetry and Native AOT support.

For apps using Microsoft's providers: `builder.Services.AddFluentAzureGuard(g => g.Required(...).Validate(key, predicate, "must ...").Sensitive("Section:*"))` validates the final IConfiguration at host startup, `AddHealthChecks().AddFluentAzureGuard()` re-checks it, and `GetRedactedDebugView()` masks secrets.

Key pipeline APIs: `FluentConfig.Create()` returns a `FluentAzure.Core.ConfigurationBuilder`, configured with `.FromEnvironment()`, `.FromJsonFile()`, `.FromKeyVault()`, `.FromAppConfiguration()`, `.UseManagedIdentity()`, `.Required()`, `.Optional()`, `.Validate()`, `.Transform()` and `.Sensitive()`, then built with `.BuildAsync()`. For ASP.NET Core and Functions, prefer `builder.Configuration.AddFluentAzureAsync(fluent => ..., reloadInterval)` plus `services.AddFluentAzureOptions<T>(configuration, "Section")`. In trimmed or Native AOT apps, avoid the reflection binders (`BuildAsync<T>()`, `Bind<T>()`) and bind options with the configuration binding source generator.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/tonyjoanes/FluentAzure/blob/main/README.md): installation, usage patterns, IConfiguration integration, identity, redaction, observability, AOT
- [IConfiguration integration](https://github.com/tonyjoanes/FluentAzure/blob/main/docs/configuration-integration.md): AddFluentAzure/AddFluentAzureAsync, reload into IOptionsMonitor, AddFluentAzureOptions, Native AOT
- [Configuration guard](https://github.com/tonyjoanes/FluentAzure/blob/main/docs/configuration-guard.md): AddFluentAzureGuard startup validation, health check and redaction over any IConfiguration, including Microsoft AddAzureAppConfiguration/AddAzureKeyVault
- [Identity & secrets](https://github.com/tonyjoanes/FluentAzure/blob/main/docs/identity-and-redaction.md): UseManagedIdentity/UseWorkloadIdentity/UseCredential, Sensitive, GetRedactedDebugView
- [Observability](https://github.com/tonyjoanes/FluentAzure/blob/main/docs/observability.md): OpenTelemetry trace/metric names and tags, health check statuses
- [App Configuration source](https://github.com/tonyjoanes/FluentAzure/blob/main/docs/app-configuration-source.md): labels, snapshots, Key Vault references, feature flags, sentinel refresh
- [Key Vault source](https://github.com/tonyjoanes/FluentAzure/blob/main/docs/key-vault-configuration-source.md): options, key mapping, retries, caching
- [Configuration binding](https://github.com/tonyjoanes/FluentAzure/blob/main/docs/enhanced-configuration-binding.md): which binder each API uses, supported shapes and known limitations
- [Analyzers](https://github.com/tonyjoanes/FluentAzure/blob/main/docs/analyzers.md): FAZ0001–FAZ0004 compile-time checks
- [Security](https://github.com/tonyjoanes/FluentAzure/blob/main/SECURITY.md): secret handling and what redaction does and does not cover

## Examples
